visualCharacteristics.purpose: list of downloadable documents (Content and Resources): file icon or thumbnail beside the document title link
visualCharacteristics.layout: one document per line, icon left, title right; links open in a new tab

contentPattern.structure: image (optional thumbnail; a document icon is shown without it, PDF style for .pdf and /gated-media links) | text (title link, optional description)

reuseGuidance: Use for document/resource link lists. The source's Resource Type filter and pagination are not implemented (items carry no type); a type cell can be added later.
